description: Apply DLSS 5 processing to the Windows desktop or a selected window, with adjustable model controls and capture tools.
notes: Requires an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-series GPU and NVIDIA driver 616.64 or newer.
Obtain nvngx_dlssnr.dll separately and place it beside FullScreenWrapperForDLSS5.exe; the application verifies the DLL signature.
The optional nvngx_dlss.dll enables the Super Resolution options. This unofficial wrapper is not an NVIDIA product.
